description: Two sample-and-hold channels, each also able to track and hold

params.text: A rising edge samples IN to OUT; the button does the same
Output follows the input while the gate is high, and holds when it drops

inputs.text: A rising edge samples that channel's input, and drives the lower section as well while nothing is patched to its own gate; the channels patched here set that section's polyphony
The voltage that channel samples; with nothing patched, it samples an internal 0-10V white noise source instead
A rising edge samples that channel's input; with nothing patched, the upper gate drives this section too

outputs.text: The voltage taken at the last sample, held until the next one

notes: IN unpatched is normalled to an internal noise source; the lower GATE is normalled to the upper one
menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, GATE input or IN input
Normal noise — the noise an unpatched IN is normalled to: Blue, White, Pink or Red
Normal range — the voltage that normalled noise covers: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V or 0V-1V
Glide — a slider setting how long the output takes to move 10V, up to 10 seconds; it is ignored in track-and-hold mode
